source.title: Guidelines for Competency Based Postgraduate Training Programme for MD in Paediatrics (revised)

requirements.label: Research Methodology course — an NMC recognized course, within six months of the batch commencing
requirements.quote: All postgraduate students shall complete an NMC recognized course in Research Methodology within six months of the commencement of the batch and generate the online certificate on successful completion of the course.
requirements.note: Paediatrics says an NMC RECOGNIZED course where the other 2022-revised curricula say an ONLINE course. Quoted as printed.

requirements.label: At least one presentation at a national/state level conference — or, if not presented at national level, one paper published/accepted in an indexed journal
requirements.quote: At least one if not two presentation(s) at national/state level conference. If not presented at national level, alternatively, one research paper should be published / accepted in an indexed journal. (It is suggested that the local or University Review committee assess the work sent for publication).
requirements.note: The Paediatrics wording differs materially from the other 2022-revised curricula: the floor is ONE (not two), STATE level counts, and the publication is an ALTERNATIVE, not an additional requirement. Evaluated as a real OR.

requirements.label: Log book of work done submitted, incl. rotation postings, departmental presentations and internal assessment reports
requirements.quote: Log book of work done during the training period including rotation postings, departmental presentations, and internal assessment reports should be submitted.

requirements.label: BCLS, Neonatal Resuscitation, Advanced Paediatric Life Support and ACLS
requirements.quote: The Postgraduate trainees should undergo training in Basic Cardiac Life Support (BCLS), Neonatal Resuscitation, Advanced Pediatric Life Support and Adult Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS).
requirements.note: WIDER than PGMER-2023 5.2(xi)(c) (BCLS + ACLS only) — paediatrics adds NRP and APLS.

proceduresNote: No procedure counts in the MD Paediatrics guidelines.
disclaimer: Requirements are traced to the NMC source named above. A requirement with target null is one the source mandates WITHOUT giving a number — it is counted, never scored against an invented target. This pack does not certify compliance; see NMC_PG_LOGBOOK_REQUIREMENTS.md.
